servinfo.title: Water Pump / Generator Drive Belt Auto Tensioner Removal and Installation

item.ptxt: Keep the retaining pin installed as it is until the tensioner is installed.
New water pump / generator drive belt auto tensioner (2) is supplied in compressed position held with a pin (1). Keep the pin installed until the tensioner is installed.

s1.ptxt: Remove water pump / generator drive belt.
Remove auto tensioner lower bolt (1) and timing chain cover bolt No.1 (2) and then remove water pump / generator drive belt auto tensioner (3).

servinfosub.title: Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Water Pump / Generator Drive Belt Auto Tensioner Inspection:K12C-Generator

servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Use new timing chain cover bolt No.1 (1).
Tighten auto tensioner lower bolt (2) and timing chain cover bolt No.1 to specified torque.
Install water pump / generator drive belt, refer to Water Pump / Generator Drive Belt Removal and Installation:K12C-Generator .
